// DERIVED FILE, but a COMMITTED SOURCE of k8000: check it in, review its
// diffs, and build from it. Nothing in k8000's lint/build/test reads any
// other repo.
//
// Do not hand-edit: it is emitted by cmd/mcrom from the Z8000 Go golden
// model's machine-cycle programs, and 'make refresh-rtl' (maintainers only,
// needs that model) will overwrite it. What proves it correct HERE is
// tb_mc_table replaying THIS FILE against
// rtl/k800x_cpu/gen/z8000_mc_rom_gen.sv.
//
// z8000_mc_table -- the machine-cycle program ROM: 434 forms, 206 programs.
// Every instruction runs its form's program; the form comes from the first
// word (a block form's second word picks single or repeat), the column from
// the mode (NS nonsegmented, SS segmented, SL once a long address word is
// in), the path from the datapath (not_taken: condition false; zero:
// multiplier or divisor 0). A divide past its width runs the default
// program, which the unit's last cycle ends.
//
// Records, whitespace separated; '#' and '//' start comments:
//
//   form  <id> <name...>                     a form (name for reading only)
//   prog  <form> <NS|SS|SL> <path> <prog>    the program a form runs
//   cycle <prog> <pos> <kind> <clocks> <reps> <next_more> <next_done> <fin_more> <fin_done>
//                                            one ROM entry: kind F1 Fn Fa R W IO
//                                            EPU AF I IA IU; clocks the tail (bus
//                                            cycles) or the length (I); reps
//                                            equal internal cycles in a row; IU
//                                            internal cycles the serial unit
//                                            ends, until its last
//   range <w0_lo> <w0_hi> <w1|-> <form>      first words w0_lo..w0_hi run form;
//                                            w1 the second word's low nibble
//                                            where it matters, else '-'
//
// The '#' line above each program is the model's program text: cycles
// joined by '·', "+k" a tail, "Ik" an internal cycle, "Ikxm" m of them
// in a row, "{rule}" the placement rule, "| n x (...)" the repeated part,
// "with n x ... inline" one run inside the body.
